records.source: Oh, hey. So you're the new guy, huh? Cool.^Hey, you're the new girl, huh? I think we're going to get along great. I'm Alex.#$e#I'll see you around.
records.translation: Ah, hoy. Ikaw pala ang bagong lalaki, ha? Astig.^Hoy, ikaw pala ang bagong babae, ha? Sa tingin ko'y magkakasundo tayo nang husto. Ako si Alex.#$e#Magkikita rin tayo.

records.source: You beat me to it! I was about to ask you...$h#$e#I'll see you out there.
records.translation: Naunahan mo ako! Yayayain na sana kita...$h#$e#Magkita tayo roon.

records.source: Aw yeah, that's the good stuff... Thanks for the birthday gift, @.
records.translation: Ayos, ito ang gusto ko... Salamat sa regalo sa kaarawan, @.

records.source: What the...? Uh, I dunno what it's like where you grew up, but to me, this is trash.$a
records.translation: Ano ba...? Uh, hindi ko alam kung ano ang nakasanayan mo sa kinalakhan mo, pero para sa akin, basura ito.$a

records.source: Whoa... this is great. Thanks!
records.translation: Whoa... napakaganda nito. Salamat!

records.source: Aw, yeah... I've been looking for this one. It's supposed to be full of tips for bulking up. Rule number one... Eat a ton of eggs! Hah, no problem! Thanks!$h
records.translation: Ayos... Matagal ko nang hinahanap ito. Punô raw ito ng mga payo sa pagpapalaki ng katawan. Unang tuntunin... Kumain ng napakaraming itlog! Hah, walang problema! Salamat!$h

records.source: Uhhh... Reading? Yeah, um... I guess I can give it a try.$s
records.translation: Uhhh... Pagbabasa? Oo, um... Siguro ay maaari kong subukan.$s

records.source: Umm... I know I'm pretty big on eggs... But this isn't what I meant...$s#$b#Oh well... Down the hatch! *gulp*$h
records.translation: Umm... Alam kong gustung-gusto ko ang mga itlog... Pero hindi ito ang ibig kong sabihin...$s#$b#Sige na nga... Lunukin na! *lagok*$h

records.source: Can you eat this?$s#$b#I guess there's only one way to find out...
records.translation: Makakain ba ito?$s#$b#Siguro ay iisa lang ang paraan upang malaman...

records.source: Hehe... Keep giving me these every day, and I'll be able to retire at thirty!$h
records.translation: Hehe... Patuloy mo akong bigyan nito araw-araw at makapagreretiro ako sa edad na tatlumpu!$h

records.source: Now that's what I call an egg! Imagine the size of the omelet...
records.translation: Iyan ang matatawag kong itlog! Isipin mo ang laki ng omelet...

records.source: Whoaa... It's so heavy I could use it for bicep curls. I'll be slurping on this for a week! Hah hah!$h
records.translation: Whoaa... Napakabigat nito, maaari ko itong gamitin sa pagpapalakas ng bisig. Isang linggo ko itong hihigupin! Hah hah!$h

records.source: Mmm... Duck egg... Rich and creamy. *crack*... *slurp*. Ahhhh...
records.translation: Mmm... Itlog ng Bibe... Malinamnam at malapot. *basag*... *higop*. Ahhhh...

records.source: Oh... um... I usually like eggs, but this one looks evil.$s
records.translation: Ah... um... Karaniwan ay gusto ko ang mga itlog, pero mukhang may masamang aura ang isang ito.$s

records.source: *crunch*... Mmm... Nuts. That hits the spot. Thanks, @!
records.translation: *Langutngot*... Mmm... Mga mani. Tamang-tama iyan. Salamat, @!

records.source: $c 0.8#Hey, thanks. Eggs are great for bulking up.#*crack*... *sluuurp*... Mmmm. Now that's what I call a snack.
records.translation: $c 0.8#Hoy, salamat. Napakahusay ng mga itlog sa pagpapalaki ng katawan.#*basag*... *higoooop*... Mmmm. Iyan ang matatawag kong meryenda.

records.source: Have you been up by the lake recently? I was on a run late last night, and I noticed that the old bridge was repaired...
records.translation: Nakapunta ka ba malapit sa lawa kamakailan? Gabing-gabi na akong tumatakbo kahapon nang mapansin kong naayos na ang lumang tulay...

records.source: Uh... I'm not used to opening up like that...$s
records.translation: Uh... Hindi ako sanay na magbukas ng damdamin nang ganoon...$s

records.source: Heard you caught some kind of rare fish?#$b#I'm impressed. Your arms must be stronger than they look! *pinch* ... not bad!$h
records.translation: Narinig kong nakahuli ka ng isang pambihirang isda?#$b#Humanga ako. Siguradong mas malakas ang mga bisig mo kaysa sa ipinahihiwatig ng hitsura ng mga ito! *kurot* ... hindi masama!$h

records.source: Hey, I overheard someone saying that you got your first chicken the other day.#$b#Man... I wish Grandma had chickens. I'd eat a dozen raw eggs for breakfast each morning!
records.translation: Hoy, narinig kong may nagsabing nakuha mo ang una mong manok noong isang araw.#$b#Naku... Sana ay may mga manok si Lola. Kakain ako ng isang dosenang hilaw na itlog tuwing almusal!

records.source: Hey... uh... @? I... feel a lot more 'at peace' after talking to you on the beach last week.$s#$b#Thanks for listening to me.$s
records.translation: Hoy... uh... @? Mas “payapa” ang pakiramdam ko matapos kitang makausap sa dalampasigan noong nakaraang linggo.$s#$b#Salamat sa pakikinig sa akin.$s

records.source: I saw you catch that salmon.#$b#If you happen to make a 'salmon dinner' out of it, let me have a bite!
records.translation: Nakita kitang hulihin ang salmon na iyon.#$b#Kung sakaling gumawa ka rito ng “Hapunan na Salmon”, patikimin mo ako!

records.source: I saw you checking out the bath house the other day. Trying to get in shape? Heh.#$e#Uh... you didn't go poking around in my locker, did you?$9
records.translation: Nakita kitang tumitingin-tingin sa Bahay-Paliguan noong isang araw. Sinisikap mong magpalakas? Heh.#$e#Uh... hindi mo naman hinalungkat ang locker ko, hindi ba?$9

records.source: What's going on out there? Any action?#$e#I gotta stay here with my grandparents...$s
records.translation: Ano ang nangyayari sa labas? May aksiyon ba?#$e#Kailangan kong manatili rito kasama ng mga lolo't lola ko...$s

records.source: I tried to go for a run this morning, but the plants have gone crazy! I couldn't get very far...
records.translation: Sinubukan kong tumakbo kaninang umaga, pero nagwala ang mga halaman! Hindi ako nakalayo...

records.source: %Alex gives your arm a squeeze, grinning.
records.translation: %Ngumingiting pinisil ni Alex ang bisig mo.

records.source: Well, this is a %season I'll never forget!$l
records.translation: Aba, hinding-hindi ko malilimutan ang %season na ito!$l

records.source: You got Haley to marry you, huh? I always figured she was out of your league!
records.translation: Napasang-ayon mo si Haley na pakasalan ka, ha? Akala ko noon ay hindi mo siya kayang abutin!

records.source: Finally, we're here!
records.translation: Sa wakas, narito na tayo!

records.source: Aw... I guess it can't last forever.$s
records.translation: Aw... Siguro ay hindi ito maaaring tumagal magpakailanman.$s

records.source: I knew I shoulda brought a frisbee... Oh well.$h
records.translation: Alam kong dapat ay nagdala ako ng frisbee... Sige lang.$h

records.source: I wonder if anyone would be up for a volleyball tournament.#$e#Don't worry, I'll go easy!$h
records.translation: May gusto kayang sumali sa isang paligsahan ng volleyball?#$e#Huwag mag-alala, hindi ko ibubuhos ang buong galing ko!$h

records.source: I wonder how far I could swim out, and still make it back?#$e#I'm guessing at least a mile.#$b#... Don't worry, I'm not going to try it.$h
records.translation: Hanggang saan kaya ako makalalangoy at makababalik pa rin?#$e#Palagay ko'y hindi bababa sa isang milya.#$b#... Huwag mag-alala, hindi ko iyon susubukan.$h

records.source: Aren't you hot in that outfit? C'mon, man... It's the beach!^Aren't you hot in that outfit? You gotta get some ocean breeze goin'!
records.translation: Hindi ka ba naiinitan sa suot mo? Sige na, pare... Nasa dalampasigan tayo!^Hindi ka ba naiinitan sa suot mo? Kailangan mong magpasariwa sa simoy ng karagatan!

records.source: With this island open, there's no excuse to be pasty anymore!
records.translation: Ngayong bukas na ang islang ito, wala nang dahilan upang manatiling maputla!

records.source: Phew, it feels good to finally get these abs a little sunlight.#$e#Kind of a shame to have them hidden away all the time back home.
records.translation: Phew, ang sarap na masikatan sa wakas ng araw ang mga masel sa tiyan ko.#$e#Sayang ding lagi na lang nakatago ang mga ito sa bahay.

records.source: When I go pro, I'll vacation on islands all around the world.#$e#But for now, this place will do just fine!$h
records.translation: Kapag propesyonal na ako, magbabakasyon ako sa mga isla sa buong mundo.#$e#Pero sa ngayon, ayos na ayos ang lugar na ito!$h

records.source: I'm ordering a banana shake with two scoops of protein powder.
records.translation: Oorder ako ng banana shake na may dalawang sandok ng pulbos na protina.

records.source: Ah... The island life. I could get used to this!
records.translation: Ah... Ang buhay sa isla. Kayang-kaya kong masanay rito!

records.source: Okay, this should be fun... I hope I can remember the moves this year! It's been a while...$h
records.translation: Sige, magiging masaya ito... Sana ay maalala ko ang mga hakbang ngayong taon! Matagal-tagal na rin...$h

records.source: Nah... I'm gonna ask someone else. Good luck.
records.translation: Nah... Iba ang yayayain ko. Sana ay suwertehin ka.

records.source: I thought we had something special... I guess I was wrong.$s
records.translation: Akala ko ay natatangi ang pagsasama natin... Mukhang nagkamali ako.$s

records.source: You're not worth my time.$a
records.translation: Hindi ka karapat-dapat sa oras ko.$a

records.source: I don't know if I can trust you anymore, but I'm willing to give you a chance.$9
records.translation: Hindi ko alam kung mapagkakatiwalaan pa kita, pero handa akong bigyan ka ng pagkakataon.$9

records.source: You're giving me wha...?$7#$b#*huff*... Got it. Alright... well, you've made your choice. You're not gonna see me begging.$a
records.translation: Ano'ng ibinibigay mo sa akin...?$7#$b#*singhal*... Nakuha ko. Sige... aba, nakapagpasiya ka na. Hindi mo ako makikitang nagmamakaawa.$a

records.source: Did you know I was an all-star quarterback in high school? It's true.$u#$e#See this little star on my jacket here? That proves it.
records.translation: Alam mo bang isa akong all-star na quarterback noong haiskul? Totoo iyon.$u#$e#Nakikita mo ang munting bituin sa dyaket ko? Patunay iyan.

records.source: The beach is a cool place to hang out and soak up some rays.#$e#You gotta spend some time in the sun or else you'll get all pale.#$e#*sigh*... I wish there were more girls in this town, know what I mean?$s^Hey, do you wanna hang out with me at the beach some time? Do you have a bikini?
records.translation: Astig na lugar ang dalampasigan upang tumambay at magbilad sa araw.#$e#Kailangan mong maglaan ng oras sa araw kung hindi ay mamumutla ka.#$e#*buntong-hininga*... Sana ay mas marami pang babae sa bayang ito, alam mo ang ibig kong sabihin?$s^Hoy, gusto mo bang tumambay kasama ko sa dalampasigan minsan? May bikini ka ba?

records.source: Looks like a good day to play catch, huh?$u#$e#$q 5/6 Wed_01_old#I'd ask you to throw the ball around, but you don't really seem like the sports type.^If you weren't a girl I'd ask you to play catch.#$r 6 0 Wed_01_02#I'm fine just watching you from a distance.#$r 5 15 Wed_01_01#I want to play catch with you!#$r 5 0 Wed_01_03#(angry) What's that supposed to mean?
records.translation: Mukhang magandang araw para magsaluhan ng bola, ano?$u#$e#$q 5/6 Wed_01_old#Yayayain sana kitang maghagisan ng bola, pero hindi ka mukhang mahilig sa isports.^Kung hindi ka babae, yayayain sana kitang magsaluhan ng bola.#$r 6 0 Wed_01_02#Ayos lang sa akin na panoorin ka mula sa malayo.#$r 5 15 Wed_01_01#Gusto kong magsaluhan tayo ng bola!#$r 5 0 Wed_01_03#(galit) Ano ang ibig sabihin niyan?

records.source: #$p 5#Go long! ...just kidding. Hahaha.|I just wish I had someone to play catch with...$s
records.translation: #$p 5#Tumakbo ka nang malayo! ...nagbibiro lang. Hahaha.|Sana ay may makasalo ako ng bola...$s

records.source: Really? I guess I underestimated you.#$b#My arm's a little sore, but maybe next time.
records.translation: Talaga? Mukhang minaliit kita.#$b#Medyo masakit ang bisig ko, pero baka sa susunod.

records.source: Yeah, some people just aren't made for sports.
records.translation: Oo, may ilang taong hindi talaga para sa isports.

records.source: Uh... never mind.
records.translation: Uh... huwag na.

records.source: The air's starting to warm up... I'm feeling pumped.
records.translation: Nagsisimula nang uminit ang hangin... Sabik na sabik ako.

records.source: Hey, what's up farmer guy?^Hey, it's farm girl. Did you get new pants? You're doing something right.#$e#Oh, I almost forgot! It's my day for doing push-ups!#$e#Every time I do push-ups I try to do one more than last time. Pretty cool strategy, huh?
records.translation: Hoy, ano'ng balita, binatang magsasaka?^Hoy, dalagang magsasaka. Bago ba ang pantalon mo? Bagay sa iyo.#$e#Ah, muntik ko nang makalimutan! Araw ko ngayong mag-push-up!#$e#Tuwing nagpu-push-up ako, sinisikap kong dagdagan nang isa ang huling bilang ko. Astig na estratehiya, hindi ba?

records.source: My arms are really sore, but that's the sign of progress for a guy like me.#$e#I must've done a thousand push-ups yesterday.
records.translation: Napakasakit ng mga bisig ko, pero tanda iyon ng pagsulong para sa isang lalaking tulad ko.#$e#Siguro ay nakagawa ako ng isang libong push-up kahapon.

records.source: Hey.#$e#What, you wanna talk to me? I'm busy.
records.translation: Hoy.#$e#Ano, gusto mo akong kausapin? Abala ako.

records.source: Hey, @.#$e#That's right, I remember your name.
records.translation: Hoy, @.#$e#Tama, naaalala ko ang pangalan mo.

records.source: Hey, @.#$e#How's your day going?
records.translation: Hoy, @.#$e#Kumusta ang araw mo?

records.source: Hey, @. I'm glad you stopped by.#$e#I'm not ashamed to say that I love my grandma!#$e#Now Grandpa, on the other hand...#$e#Just kidding.$h
records.translation: Hoy, @. Natutuwa akong dumaan ka.#$e#Hindi ko ikinahihiyang sabihing mahal ko si Lola!#$e#Pero si Lolo naman...#$e#Nagbibiro lang.$h

records.source: Nothing's better than an energetic day at the beach with your friends... right?
records.translation: Walang hihigit sa isang masiglang araw sa dalampasigan kasama ang mga kaibigan mo... hindi ba?

records.source: You know, I used to want fame and fortune, but lately I've been starting to sing a different tune. In the end it's the humble little things that satisfy, don't you think?#$e#I still want to go pro, but it's not the most important thing in the world.
records.translation: Alam mo, dati ay gusto ko ng katanyagan at kayamanan, pero nitong huli ay nag-iiba na ang pananaw ko. Sa huli, ang payak at maliliit na bagay ang nagbibigay-kasiyahan, hindi ba?#$e#Gusto ko pa ring maging propesyonal, pero hindi iyon ang pinakamahalagang bagay sa mundo.

records.source: Hi @. You look sporty today.$h^Hey @. Did you do something different with your hair? Something keeps grabbing my attention.$h
records.translation: Kumusta, @. Mukha kang atleta ngayon.$h^Hoy, @. May binago ka ba sa buhok mo? May bagay na laging umaagaw sa pansin ko.$h
